title: Sprite Lab
creator: EmulatorJS local edition
format: iNES ROM image; NROM-128 board (mapper 0), 16 KB program, 8 KB graphics, vertical mirroring
description: A teaching program: a 16 × 16 character made of four sprites walks over a two-screen world of tiles. Ten sprites share one scanline to demonstrate the NES limit of eight sprites per line, with optional flicker. Buttons trigger the pulse, triangle and noise channels.
notes: Written for the Classroom page (classroom.html) of this site.
Built from a Python script with a small two-pass 6502 assembler; both are kept with the record so the image can be rebuilt and compared byte for byte.
